title: There is a well-advanced government plan to give Taranto – now bereft of its steel industry – a future in the defence sector
dek: Il Foglio reports a well-advanced Italian government plan to give Taranto, described as now bereft of its steel industry, a future in the defence sector.
summary: According to Il Foglio's headline, the Italian government has a well-advanced plan to redirect Taranto towards the defence sector. The headline describes the city as now bereft of its steel industry. No excerpt was provided, so details of the plan are not available.
keyFacts: Il Foglio describes Taranto as now bereft of its steel industry
A government plan for a defence-sector future is described as well advanced
whyItMatters: Taranto has been home to one of Europe's largest integrated steelworks, so a shift towards defence could signal a lasting reduction in Italian flat steel capacity.
implications: If confirmed, European flat steel buyers could face a more import-reliant supply picture; readers should watch for official confirmation of the plant's status.
